Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clients

Class ClientExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.ResponseEntityExceptionHandler
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ProblemJsonExceptionHandler
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clients.ClientExceptionHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.beans.factory.Aware, org.springframework.context.MessageSourceAware
@RestControllerAdvice(assignableTypes=ClientAdminController.class) public class ClientExceptionHandler extends ProblemJsonExceptionHandler
Translates the failures of ClientAdminController to RFC 9457 problem details, answered as application/problem+json. Request validation failures are handled by the parent class.
